input.prompt: Using this military jeep only as a style and colour reference (realistic olive drab paint, dark gunmetal steel, worn edges, dried mud), draw a single game prop on its own in a realistic, photoreal 3D render style with physically based materials, NOT comic or cel-shaded, no outlines, so it sits naturally on a realistic jungle dirt road.
